Presbyopia is a common age-related vision condition that gradually affects the ability to focus on nearby objects. It typically becomes noticeable after the age of 40 and may cause difficulty reading small print, eye strain, headaches, or the need to hold reading material farther away. 

Presbyopia occurs as the eye s natural lens becomes less flexible over time, making it harder to focus on close-up tasks. While it is a normal part of the aging process, regular eye examinations are important for accurate diagnosis and appropriate vision correction. 

Depending on individual needs, management options may include reading glasses, multifocal lenses, contact lenses, or other vision correction solutions recommended by an Ophthalmologist. Early evaluation can also help identify other eye conditions that may affect vision. 

At Dr Sathe's Eye Clinic & Laser Centre, patient education and comprehensive eye care are central to our approach.
